summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, reporting a press release titled 'Notifiable trading' regarding the allocation of shares to primary insiders and their close associates under the company's share saving plan and long-term incentive programme. Shares were allocated at NOK 356.31 per share as part of a fixed monetary compensation of 20-25% of base salary, subject to a three-year lock-in period. This is a routine disclosure of insider share allocations under Norwegian securities law, not a special situation.
